definitions.name: S0A.SUM
definitions.note: sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for empty)

definitions.name: S0A.MEAN
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V S0A.SUM V LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: arithmetic mean of a non-empty Vector of numbers

definitions.name: S0A.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value, lane by lane over a number or Vector

definitions.name: S0A.ARGMAX
definitions.note: items scores -> the item with the largest score, first of ties

definitions.name: S0A.PICK
definitions.body: 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: items truths -> the items whose truth is TRUE, in order

definitions.name: S0A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET S0A.MEAN
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers

definitions.name: S0A.MAD
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V S0A.MEDIAN SUB S0A.ABS S0A.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation from the median

definitions.name: S0A.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V LENGTH 2 SUB 'N' BIND V N TAKE V 1 DROP N TAKE ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

definitions.name: S0A.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum, one lane per input lane

definitions.name: S0A.MOST-FREQ
definitions.body: TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES S0A.ARGMAX
definitions.note: most frequent element; ties go to the one appearing first

definitions.name: S0A.MODE
definitions.note: most frequent number; ties go to the smallest

definitions.name: S0A.TRIMMED
definitions.note: mean after dropping one smallest and one largest

definitions.name: S0A.WORDS
definitions.note: split a String at single spaces into words

definitions.name: S0A.JOIN-SP
definitions.note: join a non-empty Vector of Strings with single spaces

definitions.name: S0A.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case the first letter of a non-empty String

definitions.name: S0A.LONGEST
definitions.body: S0A.WORDS 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP S0A.ARGMAX
definitions.note: longest word of a text, first of ties

definitions.name: S0A.LEDGER-SPLIT
definitions.body: ZIP 'Z' BIND Z 0 GET Z 1 GET

definitions.name: S0A.BY-NAME
definitions.body: S0A.LEDGER-SPLIT GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ S0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: ledger -> Record name -> summed amount, first-appearance order

solutions.prose.initials_of_long: S0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.ledger.top_name: S0A.BY-NAME 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES S0A.ARGMAX
solutions.ledger.debtors: S0A.BY-NAME 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 0 LT S0A.PICK
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E ZIP 1 GET S0A.ARGMAX
